prompt: Photorealistic full-length studio photograph of one working-class man of about 35 with a weathered face and a short moustache, a 1912 third-class passenger: a worn brown tweed jacket with a matching waistcoat, a collarless striped cotton shirt buttoned to the neck, heavy grey wool trousers, brown leather work boots, and a tweed flat cap. The whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the feet is in frame, front view, facing the camera, standing in a relaxed A-pose with the arms held a little away from the body, empty open hands, feet slightly apart and fully visible. Plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadows, no props, no text, no logos. Historically accurate 1912 Edwardian clothing and hair, a natural realistic face, sharp fabric detail.
